03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A housekeeping skill for Swami's own skills. Many of his skills publish pages on claude.ai: skill-sheet drafts, the Skill Library, tools and dashboards. Some of those should be open to anyone with the link and some should stay private. This skill reads how each one is shared right now, compares it with how it should be shared, and tells Swami which ones to change.

In the same run it scans every one of his skills for known kinds of staleness and conflict (old tool names, old save locations, missing skills, stray files, out-of-date skill sheets and more), and rebuilds the private Skill Maintenance dashboard that shows both results. Claude cannot change sharing; it only reads it. Swami changes it himself from each page's Share menu.

Why it mattersOwner-only hiding is not privacy: anything hidden on a page is still in its source, so a page shared by link can leak what it hides. A draft shared by link would also go live the moment it is edited, before Swami vets it. A regular audit catches both.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Sharing CheckReads the sharing state of every page tied to the skills (Private, Public or Invited) with a fresh read of each page, never from a title or an old result.
  • The RuleApplies one rule: a page may be public only when everyone who could open it could see that content anyway and nothing in its source is private. Pages fall into three groups: Public, Private, and Case by case.
  • New PagesAdds any new skill-related page from the artifact listing (titles ending in "skill", the Skill Library, pages a skill builds) to sharing.json, with what it should be and why.
  • HistoryRecords every change in sharing state, and every page added or retired, in a dated history (Eastern Time).
  • Skill ScanRuns scan.py over all of Swami's skills: old tool names, old save locations, dashboard steps older than vibe-dashboard, missing skills, stray cache files, no version line, very large SKILL.md files, acronym rule conflicts, missing or out-of-date skill sheets, Fusion add-in rule conflicts and differing Comet support. Each finding is rated High, Medium or Low.
  • Known ItemsKeeps a hand-kept list (known.json) of problems the scan cannot find, and closes them once Swami has fixed them.
  • DashboardRebuilds the private Skill Maintenance dashboard with build.py in the vibe-dashboard design system (Search, Mind Map, Glossary and a spoken audio overview), then republishes it to the same link, still private.
  • ReportReplies in chat with a table of mismatches only (Title, Shared now, Should be, What to do; NDA pages first), the counts, the scan summary, and how to change sharing.
  • Update NowGives the dashboard an owner-only Update now button that starts the same run as an on-demand scheduled task, with a choice of Haiku or Sonnet for the page checks.
  • Full AuditOn request, checks every artifact on the account, not just the skill pages. That report stays in chat and never goes on the dashboard.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Fresh ReadsSharing state comes only from a fresh read of each page, so the report is never a guess.
  • Cheap ChecksPage reads run in parallel helper agents on Haiku, which keeps token use low; Sonnet is one click away when Haiku can't read a page.
  • Repeatable ScanEvery scan check is mechanical (text and file patterns), so two runs on the same skills give the same findings.
  • One ClickThe Update now button reruns the whole audit unattended in about 5 to 10 minutes and only notifies the phone when something needs Swami.
  • Privacy GateA privacy scan of the page, its data files and its narration runs before every publish.
  • Read OnlyClaude cannot change sharing. Swami changes each page from its Share menu.
  • Listing LimitThe artifact listing returns at most 200 pages and is a lower bound; older pages beyond it can be missed.
  • Skill Pages OnlyBy default only pages tied to the skills are checked. A full audit of every artifact has to be asked for.
  • Should BeClaude never changes what a page should be except for a new page; that is Swami's call, especially for the Case by case group.
  • Couldn't ReadA page that can't be read is marked "couldn't read" and keeps its last known state.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Owner-OnlyOwner-only rows, cards and columns are not privacy: they are still in the page source. A page with owner-only parts follows the rule like any other.
  • Shared DraftsA skill-sheet draft shared by link is harmless only while it matches its GitHub Pages copy; the next edit would go live before Swami vets it. Keep drafts private.
  • Cache FilesRecording the audio leaves a __pycache__ folder in the vibe-dashboard skill copy. Delete it (and run Python with -B) or the next scan reports stray files.
  • Sharing ReadOnly a read without a path reports sharing state. Reading a published file such as index.html does not.
  • CapabilitiesRepublish the dashboard without a capabilities field so it keeps its permission for the Update now button; passing an empty one removes it.
  • Recording Pages PrivateA page Swami set to Private after being told to is recorded in the history as done on the next check, not before.
  • Renamed TaskIf the Skill Maintenance update task is deleted or renamed, update TRIGGER in build.py and the task id in the skill, or the button stops working.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • Claude AccountSwami's own claude.ai account, signed in, since the pages are his artifacts.
  • CapabilitiesCode execution with network access (GitHub for the registry and the voice model), artifacts, and helper agents.
  • ConnectorThe Claude Code Remote connector, which the Update now button uses to start the scheduled task. The first click asks once to allow it.
  • MemorySwami's memory naming the people under NDA, for the privacy scan.
  • ComputerAny Mac (macOS) or Windows 10 or 11 PC with a browser, to change sharing. Nothing is installed on it.
